edition: EventWeaver successor Ω instrument network v1

retained_asset.rule: Parent compiler stays byte-identical; virtual input references are rejected by it.

mission: A verified heralded-probe decision becomes an event that starts a separate delayed calibration predicate. This adds composition across instrument decisions, not just different timing parameters.

grammar.stages: 1..4 uniquely named predicates; same lag/deadline constraints as parent
grammar.source_reference: a,b,c,veto are strings raw:0 through raw:7 or stage:<exact stage name>; four distinct references per stage
grammar.graph: All stage references must resolve; self-reference and directed cycles rejected; input list need not be topologically sorted.
grammar.outputs: One bit per stage, in the supplied list order.

semantics.virtual_delay: At logical tick t, a consumer sees producer output(t-1). All stages read the previous-output snapshot, then simultaneously update. Producer outputs start at zero.
semantics.rtl_boundary: Each core output is a registered-state bit. Direct wiring into another synchronous core therefore supplies the previous edge's output; no extra delay register is inserted.
semantics.reset: Shared synchronous rst dominates raw and virtual inputs, clears every stage and output; producer pre-reset pulses cannot survive reset.
semantics.raw: The same eight raw event bits are shared across stages. Empty masks still advance all clocks.
semantics.predicate: Identical A-B-C lag/window/endpoint-veto semantics to parent after remapping declared source references into a stage-local four-channel interface.

acceptance: Directed trace proves exactly one interface tick and expected final conditioned decision.
Late veto and reset cancel pending consumer decisions.
Invalid, unknown and cyclic references rejected before generation.
Separate conventional network plus mathematical oracle agree with generated network model and actual RTL.
Bounded symbolic equivalence against independent conventional RTL under explicit reset; depth recorded.
Fresh successor cases generated only after source/protocol freeze; no tuning from confirmation.
comparison: Direct conventional network wrapping independently implemented history cores
Successor wrapper using retained frozen EventWeaver compiler
Ordinary library containing the exact same EventWeaver artifact and same wrapper; expected identity/tie is reported

cost_policy.classification: Explicit planning estimates, not billed or observed engineering invoices
cost_policy.accounting: Successor exploration is an additional $4,100 unfunded research option. Do not count its costs inside the predecessor project twice; do not presume commercial surplus exists or finances it. Identical library incurs the same retention costs. No economic superiority is inferred from functional equivalence.
cost_policy.stop: Do not fund physical integration without a buyer-backed acceptance gate and separate capital allocation.

claim_limits: No new learned weights or independently learned specialist superiority
No physical hardware or optical feedback test
Functional network extension does not establish willingness to pay
Main commercial confirmation remains separate from this extension

fresh_confirmation_plan.selection: Independent evaluator selects fresh fixed seeds and specifications after immutable successor freeze; all failures preserved.
